items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Emma Johnson and Willa Piazza, I used to deliver drinks to those different places

ctx.x: But that place you said, what street was it on, between St. Louis and Quarantine?

Right on the corner, at Liberty and Quarantine. Liberty, oh. Yeah, right on the corner, second catacomb from St. Louis Street Cemetery, yeah. Well I had the opportunity to get in to Lula White's place, and Emma Johnson and Willa Piazza, I used to deliver drinks to those different places, and naturally it was good money in them days, the salary wasn't much but the tips were so great, you know. Well I did fairly good, and I left from there, and right after they closed the district down in 1916 I think it was. And…
